name: Auto Decorator
description: Decorates selected structures in a symmetrical black-and-white glow style.

density.name: Density
density.description: Percentage of selected objects that receive a glow composition.

amount.name: Glow rays
amount.description: Number of symmetrical white glow pairs around every decorated object.

spread.name: Spread
spread.description: Distance between the white glow rays and the black core.

decoration-object-id.name: Glow object ID
decoration-object-id.description: Glow object used for both the white rays and black core.

white-channel.name: White color channel
white-channel.description: Set this channel to white in the level color settings.

black-channel.name: Black color channel
black-channel.description: Set this channel to black in the level color settings.

seed.name: Seed
seed.description: Change this number to generate a different layout.

max-created.name: Safety limit
max-created.description: Maximum number of objects created by one click.
